read: A light, idiosyncratic Monday dominated by small-cap regulatory binaries rather than big-pharma news: Inovio more than tripled on its first-ever approval (taking Precigen down 26%), while Compass fell 27% as Usona completed its psilocybin NDA under a national priority voucher. Earnings split: Vertex nudged 2026 revenue guidance up but quietly deprioritised zimislecel, its flagship T1D islet-cell programme, while BioMarin cut revenue and EPS guidance on order timing and BD charges. Macro was risk-off for growth (Nasdaq -1.1%, healthcare lagged), but China sourcing keeps flowing (AbbVie-Brise, Fresenius-WuXi) despite the Treasury COINS draft, and a D.C. court ruling pulling Botox out of IRA negotiation hands industry a notable legal win. Private markets were quiet after last week's run of large rounds and IPOs; the tape remains selective and catalyst-driven rather than broadly risk-on.

items.headline: Inovio's Voceryq wins FDA accelerated approval in RRP; stock more than triples, Precigen -26%
items.detail: First FDA-approved DNA medicine; INO closed Monday at $1.89 vs about $0.60 Friday, while RRP rival Precigen (Papzimeos) closed down 25.9%. Ships in about 60 days; confirmatory protocol due by end-2026. Turns Precigen's RRP monopoly into a two-player market.

items.headline: Compass Pathways falls about 27% as Usona completes psilocybin NDA in MDD
items.detail: Usona holds a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (1-2 month review target), making it the second psychedelic under FDA review; Helus fell about 18%. Compass (COMP360, TRD) still expects to complete its rolling NDA in Q4 2026 and reports Q3 today.

items.headline: Vertex raises 2026 revenue guide to $13.15-13.25bn and deprioritises zimislecel for VX-017
items.detail: Q3 revenue $3.44bn (+12%); Alyftrek $706m, Casgevy $99m, Journavx $58m. Opex guide rises on the roughly $10bn Crinetics deal. Zimislecel (blood type-restricted islet cells) shelved in favour of universal allogeneic VX-017, pivotal in 2027; povetacicept IgAN PDUFA Nov 30.

items.headline: Court rules Botox must be excluded from Medicare price negotiation
items.detail: D.D.C. (ruling Oct 29, reported Monday) found Botox qualifies for the plasma-derived product exemption because of its human serum albumin component, and barred HHS from publishing a maximum fair price. Watch for an HHS appeal and read-across to other IPAY 2028 selections.

items.headline: BioMarin cuts 2026 guidance despite first $1bn quarter
items.detail: Q3 revenue $1,025m (+32%, Amicus products); FY revenue guide cut to $3.80-3.90bn and non-GAAP EPS to $2.80-3.10 (from $4.90-5.10) on a slipped international Voxzogo order and IPR&D charges (Alesta about $320m, BMN 450 about $83m). Roctavian discontinued; Voxzogo HCH PDUFA May 30, 2027.

items.headline: Fresenius takes options on up to 37 WuXi Biologics biosimilars over a decade
items.detail: Could more than double Fresenius Kabi's 29-molecule biosimilar portfolio ahead of the biologics LOE wave; terms undisclosed. Another China-sourced deal despite US Treasury's COINS draft scrutiny.

items.headline: AbbVie discloses up to $757m deal with Beijing's Brise for two preclinical migraine programmes
items.detail: Discovery-and-commercialisation deal, reportedly dating back to 2024; upfront not disclosed. Small, but another sign big pharma is sourcing early neuroscience assets from China.

items.headline: uniQure's AMT-130 Huntington's BLA accepted with priority review; PDUFA May 1, 2027
items.detail: Accelerated-approval filing on 36-month Ph1/2 data vs propensity-matched Enroll-HD external control; FDA tentatively plans an AdComm. Confirmatory 2:1 randomised trial (about 200 patients, TFC at 36 months) to start screening by end-2026. A clear path to a decision after an arduous year.

items.headline: Karyopharm files Chapter 11, with Ayrmid as lead bidder
items.detail: Up to $55m DIP from secured lenders; Ayrmid merger targeted for Q1 2027 via court-supervised sale, bid value undisclosed. Rodman says equity value could be minimal. Xpovio is the sole marketed product.

items.headline: FDA places partial clinical hold on Bright Minds' BMB-101 seizure programme; stock tanks
items.detail: Hold driven by toxicity in preclinical mouse studies; affected indications not fully detailed.

items.headline: Teva stops Phase 2 of emrusolmin in multiple system atrophy for futility
items.detail: IDMC interim analysis said the 48-week symptom-score endpoint was unlikely to be met; no safety issue. Another setback for alpha-synuclein oligomer modulation in MSA.

items.headline: Tiziana's intranasal foralumab hits PET endpoint in SPMS at 50 ug only; shares -17%
items.detail: INFORM-MS Phase 2a: 50 ug (n=19) cut microglial activation vs placebo at 12 weeks; 100 ug (n=11) missed. No disability signal; full data not released.

items.headline: Recursion extends runway into 2029; Sanofi options first development candidate
items.detail: Pro forma cash about $749m after October raise; REC-4881 cut polyp burden in 13/15 FAP patients (median -47%), registrational trial planned 2H27. $10m Sanofi milestone; Fred Hassan named chair.

items.headline: Biossil buys Theriva's antibiotic-degrading enzyme portfolio (SYN-004) for $0.35m upfront, up to $91m
items.detail: Up to $3m regulatory and $88m sales milestones plus capped low single-digit royalties; buyer is a private, Toronto-based AI-native biotech.

items.headline: CinRx and Sam Waksal's Graviton partner on ROCK2 for PAH and other cardiovascular indications
Cell and gene therapy VC hits $2.2bn in Q3 despite autoimmune CAR-T safety events
items.detail: PitchBook data via BioSpace: 51 CGT deals, behind small molecules ($3.2bn) but ahead of biologics ($1.5bn), only the second time since 2022. Comes against Novartis and BMS autoimmune CAR-T deaths and Caribou's R&D suspension.

items.headline: Specific Biologics raises $35m Series A for ALS gene editing
items.detail: Led by Hatteras Venture Partners; Toronto-based Dualase platform excises repeat expansions, lead AAV-delivered CNS candidate.
